certified_services.serviceDescription:
Securin Platform is an AI-native Preemptive Exposure Management
Platform. It shows which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to
act before attackers do. Through Offensive Exposure Validation, Securin
uses attacker techniques not scanner signatures to validate exploitability,
prioritize remediation, and prove fixes worked. It unifies external attack
surface discovery, vulnerability and threat intelligence, risk-based
prioritization, and validation into one continuous CTEM workflow: Discover,
Validate, Prioritize, Mobilize.
